title: Time range and refresh
intro: Someone in #incidents says the frontend "got slammed a few minutes ago". Zoom in on the dashboard and find out exactly when it started.

objectives.text: Set the dashboard time range to Last 15 minutes
Find when the frontend traffic spike started
objectives.question: When did the frontend traffic spike start? (times are UTC)

hints: The time range picker is in the top bar of the dashboard.
With Last 15 minutes selected, hover the chart where the frontend line jumps.
solution: Time range → Last 15 minutes. The frontend line triples at 11:51.
debrief: Over 6 hours a 4-minute spike is a thin line. Zooming in is the first move in any investigation. In real Grafana you can also drag across a chart to zoom, and press Ctrl+Z to zoom back out.
